verdict.rationale: Klaviyo documents that all /api endpoints authenticate with private API keys carrying API key scopes, which limit what third parties can access. A 'Custom' access option lets the account owner decide how much access to grant, and OAuth is available for partner apps. This covers the core of minting scoped credentials for an agent or contractor. Missing for 10: an explicit read-only key option or a documented 'analytics/reporting read without campaign-send' scope example, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
